answer_4.guideline: The annotators were instructed to rate only those parts of the expressions that refer to the type of the referential target... All items should be assigned exactly one of the following categories: • Adequate / A: The generated expression contains a valid type description for the referent. • Misaligned / M: Type designators do not apply to the intended target, but to other objects (partially) captured by the bounding box. • Omission / O: Omission of the target type... • False / F: Type designations that do not apply to the intended target or other objects captured by the bounding box.
